# /home/vgpnk/.config/systemd/user/codex-shim.service
[Unit]
Description=OAuth token-injecting proxy for OpenAI Codex backend
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
Environment=SHIM_PORT=8789
Environment=SHIM_UPSTREAM=chatgpt.com
Environment=SHIM_TOKEN_CMD=<redacted>
Environment=SHIM_MODELS=gpt-6.1-sol,gpt-6-luna
Environment=SHIM_MAX_CONCURRENT=128
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /home/vgpnk/.local/share/oauth-shim/shim.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
